objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has used [Wevtutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0645) to clear event logs within system, application and security using the commands `wevtutil cl System`, `wevtutil cl Application`, and `wevtutil cl Security`.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
